assignment: Write a short modeling review before an information desk changes staffing.
source: An analyst fits a stationary single-server queue with 8 arrivals/hour and capacity 10/hour. Under the supplied model the mean time in system is 1/(capacity minus arrivals) hours. Counts over three successive hours were 3, 6 and 15. Staff take a 15-minute break during the busiest hour. The desk has not recorded individual waiting times.

criteria.full: Computes the model estimate of 0.5 hours and identifies it as time in system under its assumptions.
criteria.partial: Computes 0.5 but labels it as observed waiting time or omits units.

criteria.full: Connects the hourly burst and break to violations of stationary arrival or capacity assumptions.
criteria.partial: Notes small data or variability without explaining model impact.

criteria.full: Proposes time-resolved simulation or a piecewise model with actual service and arrival data.
criteria.partial: Suggests a more complex model without specifying needed observations.

criteria.full: Defines a staffing pilot and a measured wait or tail metric before changing permanent coverage.
criteria.partial: Makes a permanent decision from the stationary mean alone.
